heartline.options.title: Heartline
heartline.options.enabled.tooltip: Turns everything off at once: bars above mobs, the target panel and damage numbers. The Turn Heartline On/Off key flips this in game.
heartline.options.overhead.tooltip: The health bar floating above each mob. Works on its own, with the target panel turned off.
heartline.options.visibility.tooltip: When a mob's bar shows. The mob under your crosshair always shows its bar.
heartline.options.range.tooltip: How far away, in blocks, bars still show.
heartline.options.line_of_sight.tooltip: Hide the bars of mobs you can't see. Off shows bars through walls.
heartline.options.style.tooltip: Flat: one smooth bar. Segmented: one notch per heart. Slim: a thin line without clutter. Pip: separate chunky blocks. Outline: a bordered bar with no solid backing. Glass: a glossy frosted bar. Neon: a glowing tube. Capsule: a rounded pill. Gauge: a bar over a tick scale, one tick per heart. Bracket: a thin line framed by corner brackets.
heartline.options.colors.tooltip: By Health: green to yellow to red as the mob gets hurt. By Mob Type: red hostile, yellow neutral, green passive, blue players, purple pets and bosses.
heartline.options.scale.tooltip: Makes the bars above mobs bigger or smaller.
heartline.options.height.tooltip: Moves the bars up or down, in blocks.
heartline.options.names.tooltip: Show the mob's name above its bar.
heartline.options.health_text.tooltip: How the health number under the bar reads.
heartline.options.armor.tooltip: Show a shield with the mob's armor points.
heartline.options.trail.tooltip: After a hit, the lost health stays visible for a moment and then drains away, so you can see how much each hit did.
heartline.options.fade.tooltip: How long a bar stays after a mob was last hurt (In Combat) or healed back to full (When Hurt).
heartline.options.hostile.tooltip: Bars for monsters like zombies and creepers.
heartline.options.neutral.tooltip: Bars for mobs that only fight back, like wolves, bees and endermen.
heartline.options.bosses.tooltip: Bars for bosses: the Wither, the Ender Dragon and any mob with 150 or more max health. Turn off if a boss mod already shows its own bar.
heartline.options.pets.tooltip: Your tamed pets always show their bars, even at full health.
heartline.options.hidden.tooltip: Pick which mobs never show a bar, including mobs from other mods. The Hide/Show key adds the mob you look at.
heartline.options.hidden_mobs.title: Hidden Mobs
heartline.options.hidden_mobs.search: Type a mob name to search all mods
heartline.options.hidden_mobs.show_all.t: Clear the hidden list so every mob shows its bar again.
heartline.options.hidden_mobs.mobs: Click a Mob to Hide or Show Its Bar
heartline.options.damage_numbers.tooltip: Numbers float up from mobs when they get hurt. Your critical hits show in gold with a !.
heartline.options.heal_numbers.tooltip: Green numbers when a mob heals.
heartline.options.combo.tooltip: Quick hits on the same mob add up into one growing number with a hit count, instead of a pile of small numbers.
heartline.options.number_scale.tooltip: Makes the damage numbers bigger or smaller.
heartline.options.panel.tooltip: The panel with the health and armor of the mob you're looking at or fighting. Off hides it and keeps the bars above mobs. Next to Crosshair shows a small bar under your crosshair instead.
heartline.options.hits_to_kill.tooltip: The target panel estimates how many more hits the mob takes, based on the damage your currently held item deals.
heartline.options.pet_alert.tooltip: Warns you on screen when one of your tamed pets gets low on health.
heartline.options.pet_alert_percent.tool: The pet health alert shows when a pet drops below this much health.
heartline.options.keys.tooltip: Set the keys to turn Heartline on or off and to hide the bars of the mob type you're looking at.
heartline.options.reset.tooltip: Put every setting back to its default. Hidden mob types are kept.
